statement: Pinned CWiid's cwiid_beep uses 0x14 enable then 0x19 mute, writes A20009=01, A20001=08, writes the seven-byte A20001 configuration with ADPCM format 0x00, little-endian divisor 0x0c00 and volume 0x40, writes A20008=01 and unmutes. It sends 100 report 0x18 blocks with a length control byte encoding 20 bytes, nominally spacing sends by 10,204,081 ns using a timed condition wait, then mutes and disables. It has a fixed encoded beep payload, not a general 8-bit PCM or adaptive-rate streaming interface.
